newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.26 pct in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.26 pct in volatile trade.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.26 percent in volatile trade on the commercial foreign exchange market to close at 1.0395 per dollar, dealers said.
The real fluctuated between 1.0362 and 1.0400 per dollar in speculative trade as dealers reacted to dollar inflows and outflows.
Late in the afternoon, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a Thursday deficit of around $200 million.
But dealers believe the shortfall would be less when the day's total contracts are registered.
Dealers said players will keep a close eye on dollar flows on Friday to forecast local currency direction during that day.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real closed steady again at 1.0417 per dollar. In the illegal parallel market, the real dropped 0.45 percent to end at 1.115 per greenback
